question: Who is hailed in India as the Mozart of the Madras?
solution:
The correct answer is __**A. R. Rahman.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A. R. Rahman** is a renowned **Indian music composer, singer, and songwriter.**
 
• He is known as the Mozart of the Madras.
 
• He has won **several national and international awards** for his contribution to the **music industry.**
 
• Rahman is known for his unique fusion of **Indian classical music** with** electronic music, world music**, and traditional **orchestral arrangements.**
 
• He is also the first Indian to win** two Academy Awards, two Grammy Awards, a BAFTA Award, and a Golden Globe **for his work in the film **Slumdog Millionair**e.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Udit Narayan**, is a popular** Indian playback singer **who has sung in several Bollywood films.
 
• **S. P. Balasubrahmanyam, **was a legendary Indian playback singer who passed away in** 2020.**
 
• **Arijit Singh,** is a** popular Indian playback singer **who has won several awards for his soulful singing.
